name: SyncPlay
description: Sync your Spotify playlists and Liked Songs to YouTube Music automatically. Bring your own free Spotify Developer app, map Spotify sources to YouTube Music playlists, and SyncPlay keeps them in step — new tracks are added as they appear, nothing is removed unless you enable pruning. YouTube connects through your existing Otix Google account, or through your own Google Cloud app. Full setup steps live in the Setup Guide tab.
author: Otix

spotify_client_id.label: Spotify Client ID
spotify_client_id.description: Your Spotify app's Client ID. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard and add redirect http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback. Full steps in the Setup Guide tab.

spotify_client_secret.label: Spotify Client Secret
spotify_client_secret.description: Your Spotify app's Client Secret (click "Show Client Secret" on the same page). Kept local — it lets anyone with it act as your app.

google_client_id.label: Google OAuth Client ID (optional)
google_client_id.description: Optional. Leave blank to connect YouTube through your existing Otix Google account. For your own Google Cloud app, create an OAuth Client ID (Desktop/Web), add redirect http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback, and enable the YouTube Data API v3. Steps in the Setup Guide tab.

google_client_secret.label: Google OAuth Client Secret (optional)
google_client_secret.description: From the same Google Cloud OAuth client. Only needed if you filled in the Google Client ID above.

playlists.label: Mappings to Sync
playlists.description: Map a Spotify source (a playlist or your Liked Songs) to a YouTube Music playlist.

source.label: Sync Source
source.description: playlist = a specific Spotify playlist (paste its URL/ID below); liked = your Spotify Liked Songs library

spotify_playlist.label: Spotify Playlist (URL or ID)
spotify_playlist.description: Used when Sync Source is "playlist". e.g. https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1... or just the ID

yt_title.label: YouTube Music Playlist Title
yt_title.description: Created on YouTube Music if it doesn't exist yet.

match_mode.label: Match Mode
match_mode.description: auto = always add the best search match; strict = skip weak or unclear matches

quota_budget.label: YouTube quota budget per run
quota_budget.description: YouTube Data API units per sync run (search = 100, add = 50). Stops before exceeding.
